swipe.wasTrue: Not quite — this definition does match the term.
swipe.wasFalse: Not quite — the correct definition is: {{answer}}
swipe.keys: Use ← (False) and → (True), or swipe the card.

memory.name: Memory cards
memory.title: Memory card game
memory.hint: Flip two cards at a time to match each term with its definition. The fewer flips, the more stars; each star is worth {{n}} points.
memory.editorHint: Students flip cards to match terms with definitions. Definitions must be different.

match.name: Matching
match.title: Matching
match.hint: Pick a term, then pick its definition. The fewer wrong matches, the more stars; each star is worth {{n}} points.
match.editorHint: Students connect terms in the left column with definitions in the right column. Definitions must be different.

swipe.name: True / False
swipe.title: True or False?
swipe.hint: Does the definition below match the term? The fewer mistakes, the more stars; each star is worth {{n}} points.
swipe.editorHint: Each pair is shown sometimes correctly and sometimes mixed up with another definition; students answer True/False. Use at least 3 pairs for more variety.

scramble.name: Word scramble
scramble.title: Word scramble
scramble.hint: Read the hint and arrange the pieces into the right term. The fewer wrong tries, the more stars; each star is worth {{n}} points.
scramble.editorHint: Students read the hint and unscramble the term (one word: arrange letters; several words: arrange words).

gameEditor.title: End-of-lesson games
gameEditor.rule: Up to {{maxGames}} games per lesson, {{min}}–{{max}} pairs each. After completing the lesson, students play them to earn bonus points. Leave empty = no game.
gameEditor.errMin: at least {{min}} pairs are needed (or remove this game).
gameEditor.errScramble: the word to unscramble needs at least 2 different letters (or 2 different words).
